usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v with JSON body {image, prompt, resolution?, duration?, negativePrompt?, seed?, enablePromptExpansion?, multiShots?, audioUrl?}. Pay x402/MPP USDC on Base (dynamic price ~$0.50-2.25, registry surface $10 is the cap not the charge). Returns async job {success, jobId, status:"pending", type}. Then poll the result with SIWX auth: GET https://stablestudio.io/api/jobs/{jobId} (SIGN-IN-WITH-X header, no payment).
usage.outputShape: Generate call: body.jobId (string), body.status ("pending"), body.success (true), body.type ("wan-2.6-i2v"). Poll call (GET /api/jobs/{jobId}, SIWX): body.status ("pending"|"loading"|"complete"|"failed"), body.progress, body.error, and on success body.result.videoUrl + body.result.thumbnailUrl.
quirks: DYNAMIC PRICING: registry surface says $10.00 but that is the cap/max; actual charge is ~$0.50-2.25 (observed $0.50 for 5s 720p). x402/MPP USDC on Base or Solana.

Two-step async: POST returns {jobId, status:'pending'} only. The finished video is NOT in the POST response. You MUST poll GET /api/jobs/{jobId} until status='complete', then read body.result.videoUrl.

POLL IS SIWX, NOT PAID: GET /api/jobs/{jobId} requires a SIGN-IN-WITH-X (CAIP-122 wallet signature) header, returns 402 with a sign-in-with-x extension if unsigned. It is free (no USDC). Use --siwx in qa-pay / agentcash fetch handles it.

IMAGE MUST BE A VERCEL BLOB URL from the File Upload flow (POST /api/upload $0.01 -> PUT to blob -> POST /api/upload/confirm). Arbitrary external image URLs can PASS the cheap synchronous validator and get you charged, but then the upstream Wan backend may 403/fail when it fetches them (Wikimedia hotlink-blocked our test, job ended status='failed'). Do NOT use random web image URLs.

Pre-charge validator rejects some URLs with 400 'Invalid image URL' before payment (e.g. Wikimedia /thumb/ resized paths) — no money lost on those, but it is not a reliable signal that a passing URL will actually generate.
Video models take 2-5 min; poll every ~15s. Do NOT resubmit while status is 'pending' or 'loading' — duplicate submissions create duplicate paid jobs.
Result videoUrl/thumbnailUrl expire after ~20 minutes — download the video immediately on completion.
i2v requires both 'image' and 'prompt'. duration enum '5'|'10'|'15' (string), resolution '720p'|'1080p'.
multiShots only takes effect when enablePromptExpansion is true. audioUrl must be HTTPS mp3/wav, 3-30s, <=15MB.
Canonical/base origin in provider guidance is stablestudio.dev; the registry/working CALL host stablestudio.io also serves the same API and was used successfully.
usage.guide: Wan 2.6 image-to-video. STEP 1: upload your source image via the File Upload flow (POST https://stablestudio.io/api/upload with {filename,contentType} for $0.01, PUT the bytes to the returned Vercel Blob clientToken/pathname, then POST /api/upload/confirm) to get a blobUrl — do not pass an arbitrary external image URL, the backend often 403s on those. STEP 2: POST https://stablestudio.io/api/generate/wan-2.6/i2v with JSON {image: <blobUrl>, prompt, duration?, resolution?}; pay USDC on Base (real cost ~$0.50-2.25, not the $10 surface). You get back {jobId, status:'pending'}. STEP 3: poll GET https://stablestudio.io/api/jobs/{jobId} with a SIGN-IN-WITH-X (SIWX) signature header (free, not a payment) every ~15s until status='complete', then read the video at body.result.videoUrl (download within ~20 min before the URL expires). Never resubmit while pending/loading.
